craft_notes: Sthāyin: mechanism. Sanskrit-first: ablative cause kept. Rows: 2. Close: called. Rejected: materialism — killed: grasp, not physics, conceals. Read aloud: lifting cadence.

lines: Forget the flesh, and up you go.
l4.sanskrit_cite: udbhavo laghubhāvena dehagrahatirohiteḥ | deho hi pārthivo mukhyastadā mukhyatvamujjhati
